responsibility: This file implements higher-level templated diagnostic construction on top of mcError for the mc front end. It parses meta-format strings with variable arguments, decides whether a message creates a new error, warning, or chained continuation, supports both current-token and explicit-token variants, and emits the resulting DynamicStrings messages into mcError records, making it the front end's richer semantic-error formatting layer above the lower-level basic error API.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the executable formatting layer declared in GmcMetaError.h, implementing the meta-format parsing, varargs handling, current-token lookup via mcLexBuf, and creation/chaining of mcError records.
